annotations.title: Shops the signed-in person looks after

description: The shops whose numbers the signed-in person may read: a contact of a shop in Fordeal's own affiliate programme whose partnership the operator approved and whose domain is proven (`access: partner`; a pending partner sees nothing here), or the contact e-mail of a registration the operator approved (`access: registration`). Needs that person's Supabase access token (Authorization: Bearer <token>, the website holds it after the e-mail sign-in link); an agent API key is refused. Each row: slug, name, domain, country, status, access, the shop's page. Next: get_shop_statistics with a slug.
name: list_my_shops
title: Shops the signed-in person looks after
